checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add chord-to-arpeggio transformation

impact_assessment.why: Chords are easy to write as simultaneous notes but there is no way to roll them into a sequence.
impact_assessment.benefits: arpeggiate spreads each simultaneity across a grid with unchanged notes and deterministic ordering.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: note count and fields must be preserved, ordering must be stable, and invalid grids must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for grid spacing, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 265 tests green; grid spacing, field preservation and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-arpeggiate' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add melodic inversion

impact_assessment.why: Time reversal and transposition exist, but mirroring pitches around a center note is a distinct compositional transform.
impact_assessment.benefits: invert reflects every pitch around a chosen center while preserving rhythm, velocity, pan and timbre.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: center must parse as a note, reflected pitches must stay in MIDI range, and invalid input must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for pitch reflection, field preservation and round-trip, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 270 tests green; pitch reflection, field preservation and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-invert' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add score range extraction

impact_assessment.why: WAVs can be trimmed but scores cannot; pulling a phrase out of a longer score requires a source-level extract.
impact_assessment.benefits: extract keeps and clips notes overlapping a beat range, producing editable canonical source with all other fields intact.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ranges must be valid, clipped starts and durations must be exact, and output must round-trip; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for clipping and preservation, a CLI command reusing the time options, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 275 tests green; range clipping, preservation and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-extract' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add repeating accent patterns

impact_assessment.why: Velocity can be set per note in a score but there is no fast way to apply a repeating accent groove.
impact_assessment.benefits: accent cycles a velocity pattern across sounding notes deterministically, leaving timing, pitch and timbre unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: velocities must be valid, rests must be skipped, and invalid patterns must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for pattern cycling, rest skipping and round-trip, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add register fitting by octave displacement

impact_assessment.why: Transpose shifts all pitches by a fixed interval and invert mirrors them, but there is no way to fold stray notes into a target pitch range.
impact_assessment.benefits: register octave-displaces each sounding pitch into [low,high], preserving rhythm, velocity, pan and timbre as editable canonical source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: bounds must be valid notes with low below high, rests untouched, out-of-range results skipped, and output must round-trip; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for octave folding, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command with --low/--high, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 289 tests green; octave folding, field preservation, round-trip and bound validation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-register' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a downward noise gate for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: trim only removes silence at file edges; there is no way to silence quiet frames between phrases of an existing WAV.
impact_assessment.benefits: gate silences frames below a dBFS threshold while leaving louder frames byte-identical, with exact frame and rate preservation.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: threshold must be a valid dBFS value, quiet frames zeroed, loud frames untouched, invalid WAVs rejected; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for threshold behaviour and identity, a CLI command reusing --threshold, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 294 tests green; selective gating, pass-through identity, all-frame gating and bounds pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-gate' completed successfully.
